workRoots.description: Git toplevels under any prefix are "work" mode. The first entry is also the parent of the sh-devctl repo: the /validate gate resolves its scripts as <workRoot>/sh-devctl/scripts.

items.description: Absolute path prefix of a work repo root

avenWorkspace.description: Aven workspace name or key forced on every aven call pi-flow makes (skips cwd inference and the search fallback).

yolo.description: Run /flow phases without confirmation gates (personal mode only — work-mode runs refuse yolo at loop start). Only applies when the --yolo flag is absent on the /flow invocation — an explicit flag wins over config

viewerPlacement.description: Default Herdr pane placement for /flow-view when no placement argument is given

landTestCommand.description: Argv of the test command flow_land runs before authorizing a landing (default ["bun","run","test"]). PMR-05HX: the landing gate never trusts a claimed-green suite.

enabled.description: Master switch — telemetry subscribes to nothing when false/absent (PMR-R8AG)

otlpEndpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL (e.g. https://host:4478); spans POST to <endpoint>/v1/traces

headers.description: Static extra headers for OTLP export. Secrets belong in env (PI_FLOW_OTLP_TOKEN), not config

captureContent.description: Content captured on spans (cumulative): off = metadata only (default), text = assistant text, tools = + tool calls the model made and tool input/output, all = + model reasoning. Captured content can contain secrets and lands in the trace backend

jiraBaseUrl.description: Base URL for Jira issue links, e.g. https://example.atlassian.net/browse/ — work-mode spans then carry flow.url = <base><jira key> so dashboards can link tickets. Absent = no links

maxContentChars.description: Max characters per captured content attribute (default 2000). Tempo truncates attribute values beyond max_attribute_bytes (default 2048) silently — raise both together

loki.description: Optional Loki transition-event stream, session-side only (PMR-ZV9Y 4.2)

enabled.description: Push flow transition-event streams to Loki. Default false (disabled — zero network calls)

endpoint.description: Loki base URL (user-provided, e.g. http://loki.example.com:3100); events POST to <endpoint>/loki/api/v1/push. Required with telemetry.loki.enabled

headers.description: Static extra headers for the Loki push. Secrets belong in env, not config

notify.description: Flow-state notifications (PMR-ZV9Y 5.2). The desktop channel pages on waiting_human / halted transitions through pi-desktop-notify; Grafana alerting is the independent second channel (paused/muted in Grafana).

desktop.description: Desktop channel via @gtheys/pi-desktop-notify (optional dependency — absent package degrades to one journal note)

enabled.description: Send a desktop notification on waiting_human / halted flow transitions through pi-desktop-notify. Default true (opt-out)
Kill switch for the durable run server (PMR-XTQQ). false = never spawn the daemon and journal writers permanently use today’s full in-session path. Default true

reconcile.description: Pushgateway liveness reconcile (PMR-V36Y). Tombstones the v2 pi_flow_state / pi_flow_state_start_seconds series (state halted/waiting_human/waiting_machine -> stale) whose aven ticket is not live (neither active nor todo), so the alerts stop firing on closed runs.

enabled.description: Reconcile stale run-liveness metrics (tombstone the v2 pi_flow_state series whose aven ticket is not live (neither active nor todo): state halted/waiting_human/waiting_machine becomes stale). Default true

intervalMinutes.description: Daemon reconcile interval in minutes. Default 360 (6h)

liveness.description: Run-liveness pushes while flows are in flight (PMR-8MQH). Every interval the daemon stamps the current loop state of each running flow onto its v2 pi_flow_state{state="running"} series (via the shared buildPushBody render), so `running` alerts and dashboards reflect a live loop instead of the last journal write.

enabled.description: Push run-liveness metrics for flows in flight. Default true

intervalMinutes.description: Daemon liveness push interval in minutes. Default 5. An interval change applies on the next cycle — no daemon restart needed
